en.title: About Mistboard | Chinese Chess for Every Player
en.description: Bringing people together across cultures through Chinese chess and the world's classic strategy games. Free, open-source play, study and broadcasts.

zh-Hans.title: 关于 Mistboard | Mistboard
zh-Hans.description: Mistboard 是免费、开源的中国象棋对弈与学习网站，支持英文、简体中文和繁体中文。通过中国象棋与世界经典策略游戏，让不同文化背景的人走到一起。

zh-Hant.title: 關於 Mistboard | Mistboard
zh-Hant.description: Mistboard 是免費、開源的象棋對弈與學習網站，支援英文、簡體中文和繁體中文。透過象棋與世界經典策略遊戲，連結不同文化背景的人。

en.title: Open Source Code | Mistboard
en.description: Mistboard is an independent open-source project, published under AGPL-3.0-or-later. Browse the repository and the license.

zh-Hans.title: 开放源代码与第三方组件 | Mistboard
zh-Hans.description: Mistboard 是一个独立的开源策略游戏项目。源代码以 AGPL-3.0-or-later 发布。托管服务与 lichess、chess.com 或任何其他棋类平台无关联。

zh-Hant.title: 開放原始碼與第三方元件 | Mistboard
zh-Hant.description: Mistboard 是一個獨立的開源策略遊戲專案。原始碼以 AGPL-3.0-or-later 發布。託管服務與 lichess、chess.com 或任何其他棋類平台無關。

en.title: Frequently Asked Questions | Mistboard
en.description: Which games are hosted, whether you need an account, how rated play and cheat prevention work, and where the game library comes from.

zh-Hans.title: 常见问题：对弈、账号与计分 | Mistboard
zh-Hans.description: 关于 Mistboard 网页版的常见问题：如何与电脑或朋友下象棋，是否需要下载或注册账号，计分对局与防作弊如何运作，以及棋谱库的对局来自哪里。

zh-Hant.title: 常見問題：對弈、帳號與計分 | Mistboard
zh-Hant.description: 關於 Mistboard 網頁版的常見問題：如何與電腦或朋友下象棋，是否需要下載或註冊帳號，計分對局與防作弊如何運作，以及棋譜庫的對局來自哪裡。

en.title: Terms of Use: Play, Ratings and Fair Play | Mistboard
en.description: The rules for using mistboard.com: anonymous and rated play, ratings and fair play, finished games published under CC BY 4.0, and patron billing and refunds.

zh-Hans.title: 使用条款：对弈、计分与公平竞赛 | Mistboard
zh-Hans.description: 使用 mistboard.com 的规则：匿名与计分对弈、账号和评分、公平竞赛要求、已结束对局按 CC BY 4.0 公开的许可，以及赞助扣款、取消和退款规定。

zh-Hant.title: 使用條款：對弈、計分與公平競賽 | Mistboard
zh-Hant.description: 使用 mistboard.com 的規則：匿名與計分對弈、帳號和評分、公平競賽要求、已結束對局按 CC BY 4.0 公開的授權，以及贊助扣款、取消和退款規定。

en.title: Privacy: What Mistboard Collects | Mistboard
en.description: What mistboard.com collects and why: analytics, the games you play, and your handle and email if you make an account. No ads, and no data sold.

zh-Hans.title: 隐私政策：网站收集的数据与用途 | Mistboard
zh-Hans.description: 说明 mistboard.com 收集的分析数据、对局记录，以及注册账号时的用户名和邮箱；介绍这些数据的用途、计分对局的公平性数据与私信的保存。网站无广告，也不出售你的数据。

zh-Hant.title: 隱私政策：網站收集的資料與用途 | Mistboard
zh-Hant.description: 說明 mistboard.com 收集的分析資料、對局記錄，以及註冊帳號時的使用者名稱和信箱；介紹這些資料的用途、計分對局的公平性資料與私訊的保存。網站無廣告，也不出售你的資料。

en.title: Contact: Bugs, Accounts and Billing | Mistboard
en.description: A private line to the person who runs Mistboard: report a bug or a broken game, or raise an account or billing problem. Add an email if you want a reply.

en.title: How to Contribute | Mistboard
en.description: Ways to contribute to Mistboard as a player, teacher, translator, game creator or engine author, and where each one starts.

zh-Hans.title: 参与贡献：玩家、教师与开发者 | Mistboard
zh-Hans.description: Mistboard 免费且开源，玩家、教师、游戏创作者和引擎作者都可以参与。从一件你在意、想改进的事开始：下棋并反馈问题、审阅中文翻译、制作教学内容，或提交代码与引擎。

zh-Hant.title: 參與貢獻：玩家、教師與開發者 | Mistboard
zh-Hant.description: Mistboard 免費且開源，玩家、教師、遊戲創作者和引擎作者都可以參與。從一件你在意、想改進的事開始：下棋並回報問題、審閱中文翻譯、製作教學內容，或提交程式碼與引擎。

en.title: Work With Us: Creators and Players | Mistboard
en.description: Work with Mistboard on teaching, broadcasts, original games and engine challenges across languages, and how to get in touch.

zh-Hans.title: 与我们合作：创作者与棋手 | Mistboard
zh-Hans.description: Mistboard 将对弈和研究与赛事直播、原创游戏和引擎挑战赛连接起来。我们跨越语言，在线上和线下与棋手、教师、创作者及主办方合作。网站免费、开源、无广告。

zh-Hant.title: 與我們合作：創作者與棋手 | Mistboard
zh-Hant.description: Mistboard 將對弈和研究與賽事直播、原創遊戲和引擎挑戰賽連結起來。我們跨越語言，在線上和線下與棋手、教師、創作者及主辦方合作。網站免費、開源、無廣告。

en.title: Engine Champions | Mistboard
en.description: The reigning champion engine for jieqi, banqi, Jungle Chess and Flip Jungle: the strongest bot on Mistboard, the title history, and how any engine can challenge for the title in a public match.

zh-Hans.title: 引擎冠军与挑战赛 | Mistboard
zh-Hans.description: 揭棋、暗棋、斗兽棋和翻翻兽棋的现任冠军引擎：Mistboard 上最强的机器人，附头衔历史，以及任何引擎如何在公开对抗赛中挑战头衔。

zh-Hant.title: 引擎冠軍與挑戰賽 | Mistboard
zh-Hant.description: 揭棋、暗棋、鬥獸棋和翻翻獸棋的現任冠軍引擎：Mistboard 上最強的機器人，附頭銜歷史，以及任何引擎如何在公開對抗賽中挑戰頭銜。

en.title: Xiangqi Video Library | Mistboard
en.description: Curated xiangqi (Chinese chess) videos in English and Chinese: rules, openings, tactics, endgames and commented games. Search by title or author, or by topic.

zh-Hans.title: 象棋视频库：规则、开局与残局 | Mistboard
zh-Hans.description: 精心挑选的中文与英文象棋（中国象棋）视频，内容涵盖规则、开局、战术、残局和讲解对局。可以按标题或作者搜索，也可以按主题筛选。

zh-Hant.title: 象棋影片庫：規則、開局與殘局 | Mistboard
zh-Hant.description: 精心挑選的中文與英文象棋（中國象棋）影片，內容涵蓋規則、開局、戰術、殘局和講解對局。可以按標題或作者搜尋，也可以按主題篩選。

en.title: About the Game Data | Mistboard
en.description: What the Mistboard monthly game files hold: the JSONL and PGN formats field by field, the CC BY 4.0 license, which games are included, and how fog and face-down pieces appear.

zh-Hans.title: 关于棋谱数据：格式与使用许可 | Mistboard
zh-Hans.description: Mistboard 每月对局数据说明：逐项介绍 JSONL 和 PGN 文件格式、CC BY 4.0 许可与署名方式、包含和排除哪些对局，以及迷雾和暗子信息如何记录。

zh-Hant.title: 關於棋譜資料：格式與使用授權 | Mistboard
zh-Hant.description: Mistboard 每月對局資料說明：逐項介紹 JSONL 和 PGN 檔案格式、CC BY 4.0 授權與署名方式、包含和排除哪些對局，以及迷霧和暗子資訊如何記錄。

en.title: Forum etiquette · Mistboard
en.description: A clear title, the right category, readable boards, no spam and respect for other players: guidelines for posting on the Mistboard forum.

description: Embed a study chapter, a game, Mistboard TV, the daily puzzle or an analysis board on your own page.

en.title: Developers: Embeds and API | Mistboard
en.description: Embed a xiangqi board with engine annotations in your own page. A public study chapter runs in an iframe with no API key, and Mistboard is an oEmbed provider.

description: The public Mistboard HTTP API: endpoints, parameters and responses from the OpenAPI document.

en.title: Public Read API Reference | Mistboard
en.description: The public read API behind mistboard.com: games, watch feeds, puzzles, studies, ratings, the xiangqi opening explorer and the forum, as an OpenAPI 3.1 document.

en.title: Import a Xiangqi Game | Mistboard
en.description: Paste a xiangqi (Chinese chess) game and get a browsable board with free engine analysis. Reads PGN, WXF, Chinese notation, ICCS coordinates, and dpxq records.

en.title: Xiangqi Game Database | Mistboard
en.description: Search and browse xiangqi (Chinese chess) and variant games: tournament archives, live broadcasts, engine matches, and games played on Mistboard. Filter by variant, player, event, result, date, or length.

en.title: Xiangqi Practice | Mistboard
en.description: Practise xiangqi (Chinese chess) endgames against the engine: each position sets a goal, the engine defends, and it tells you when the win has slipped.

zh-Hans.title: 象棋残局练习：与电脑对练 | Mistboard
zh-Hans.description: 和电脑练习象棋残局：每个局面都设定一个目标，比如将死对方或守和若干回合，电脑负责防守，一旦你把胜势丢掉，它会马上提示你。

zh-Hant.title: 象棋殘局練習：與電腦對練 | Mistboard
zh-Hant.description: 和電腦練習象棋殘局：每個局面都設定一個目標，比如將死對方或守和若干回合，電腦負責防守，一旦你把勝勢丟掉，它會馬上提示你。

en.title: Xiangqi Analysis Board | Mistboard
en.description: Analyse xiangqi (Chinese chess) positions with a free engine. Import moves or a FEN, branch variations, review any game. Mistboard variants supported too.

zh-Hans.title: 象棋AI分析 · 皮卡鱼引擎免费分析棋盘 | Mistboard
zh-Hans.description: 免费的象棋AI分析棋盘：在浏览器里用皮卡鱼引擎分析任意局面。可以粘贴棋谱或 FEN 导入，摆出变着分支，复盘任何一盘对局。无需下载，也无需注册账号。

zh-Hant.title: 象棋AI分析 · 皮卡魚引擎免費分析棋盤 | Mistboard
zh-Hant.description: 免費的象棋AI分析棋盤：在瀏覽器裡用皮卡魚引擎分析任意局面。可以貼上棋譜或 FEN 匯入，擺出變著分支，復盤任何一盤對局。無需下載，也無需註冊帳號。

en.title: Xiangqi Board Editor | Mistboard
en.description: Set up any xiangqi (Chinese chess) position by hand, get its FEN, and send it to the free analysis board. Mistboard variants supported too.

zh-Hans.title: 象棋摆残局 · 免费棋盘编辑器 | Mistboard
zh-Hans.description: 在棋盘编辑器里摆出任意象棋局面或残局：逐个放置棋子，设定走棋方，实时得到局面的 FEN，再一键送到分析棋盘让引擎分析，或者从这个局面开始和电脑对练。免费，无需注册。

zh-Hant.title: 象棋擺殘局 · 免費棋盤編輯器 | Mistboard
zh-Hant.description: 在棋盤編輯器裡擺出任意象棋局面或殘局：逐個放置棋子，設定走棋方，即時得到局面的 FEN，再一鍵送到分析棋盤讓引擎分析，或者從這個局面開始和電腦對練。免費，無需註冊。

title: Xiangqi Leaderboard | Mistboard
description: The highest rated players on Mistboard, by game and time control. Rated games are played between signed-in accounts in xiangqi, jieqi, banqi, Jungle and more.

title: Updates and Announcements | Mistboard
description: Every Mistboard release, article, and status update, newest first: new variants, engine work, and changes to the site.

title: Changelog: Every Change, Month by Month | Mistboard
description: Every change to mistboard.com, month by month, newest first: playing, learning, watching, community, the site, removals and fixes, each linking its commit.

title: Learn Chinese Chess (Xiangqi) | Mistboard
description: A free interactive xiangqi course in English. Learn the pieces, the rules, and core tactics by playing them.

zh-Hans.title: 学下象棋：免费互动入门课程 | Mistboard
zh-Hans.description: 免费的互动象棋入门课程，边玩边学：从七种棋子的走法和摆棋开始，再学吃子、保护、将军、应将、将死、困毙和长将等规则与基本战术。

zh-Hant.title: 學下象棋：免費互動入門課程 | Mistboard
zh-Hant.description: 免費的互動象棋入門課程，邊玩邊學：從七種棋子的走法和擺棋開始，再學吃子、保護、將軍、應將、將死、困斃和長將等規則與基本戰術。

title: Xiangqi Puzzles | Mistboard
description: Free xiangqi (Chinese chess) puzzles drawn from real games, with puzzles for Mistboard variants alongside.

title: Become a Patron | Mistboard
description: Mistboard is independent and ad-free. Core play and learning stay free. Patron is an optional monthly subscription with a profile badge.

title: Xiangqi Streamers | Mistboard
description: Stream xiangqi or its variants with Mistboard. Bring an idea, prepare games and studies, and work directly with us as our tools for creators develop.
